vert: Image 1 is a movie poster, Image 2 is a photo of a man. Edit Image 1 and keep EVERYTHING the same: the same composition, framing, cold blue color grade, snowstorm, cracked ice road, the truck with its trailer in the same position and angle, the two men running toward it, the lighting, film grain and overall poster style. Change only these four things: 1) Replace the face and head of the man at the top with the man from Image 2, keeping his exact likeness (face shape, beard, dark hair, and his dark sunglasses with gold frame), same size, angle and position as the original head, lit and color graded in the same cold blue poster style. 2) Remove the small white actor name line above the title completely, leave clean sky there. 3) Replace the big title with EXACT TEXT in Russian Cyrillic, verbatim, no extra characters: АККАУНТ on the first line and ЗАМОРОЖЕН on the second line, in the same bold condensed red-orange poster font, same position and same size as the original title. 4) Repaint the truck cab and trailer in a glossy black livery with orange-yellow (#F7A600) stripes and the large orange-yellow wordmark BYBIT on the trailer side. No other text anywhere, no watermark.
horiz: Image 1 is a movie poster, Image 2 is a photo of a man.
